command_proposal.format: Separate versioned fixed-verb ASCII grammar, request32hex, currentbootUUID, OPEN or TERMINATE with bounded positive expectedPID and process-incarnation token where needed. No arbitrary executable, path, bundle identifier, environment or shell.
command_proposal.bounds: At most8 launch-control requests per run, reject duplicate IDs, one in-flight child, finite120s child lifetime, no automatic replay; retain existing32 HID gesture cap separately. While control child runs, reject additional control/input requests rather than silently queue ambiguous work.
command_proposal.execution: HID parser forks only a fixed trusted owned controller executable. Child execs fresh process before Objective-C work; closes inherited console read FD, never reads console/stdin; inherits output only. Drop groups/gid/uid501 before invoking existing original LS open API as already executed by current wrapper. Parent remains sole reader and reaps with bounded WNOHANG polling.
command_proposal.open_only: Add an explicit mode in the existing owned launcher that opens only org.inferno.companion.probe through the same original nil-configuration LS API, one attempt, no registration/metadata update. Stamp request/callback as current timing candidate. ACK is service result, not active/frame success.
command_proposal.implementation_gate: Parent review plus exact new process-incarnation query ABI/permission audit before code.

warm_trial: Root uses ordinary Home/background gesture. Require actual app didEnterBackground record; resignation alone can mean an overlay/lock rather than background.
Verify same exact executable/uid501/PID/incarnation remains alive, then issue explicit OPEN.
Require same incarnation, next willEnterForeground/active lifecycle records, and no new main. Preserve capture proof separately.

If exact owned app icon is actually visible and identified, ordinary icon tap is a simpler no-command alternative. Its visibility has not been established, and host tap-to-active is a different metric from LS-request-to-active.
process_cold_trial: Separate explicit TERMINATE from OPEN. Original positive-PID SIGTERM only after exact owned executable/UID/currentboot/incarnation revalidation; record original syscall return and errno. Original MAC applies before root/same-user rules; permission is not assumed.
Boundedly verify prior incarnation no longer runs; do not treat kill return0 or a zombie as sufficient. No SIGKILL escalation.
Only then a separate explicit OPEN. Require new process incarnation/main and full first-launch hooks. Label process-cold/cache-warm, not storage-cache-cold.

PID check and kill are not atomic; retain this residual race honestly. If stronger atomic identity safety is required, investigate an original supported identity-aware termination API before implementation rather than claiming the check eliminates it.
event_changes: Separate bounded lifecycle-timing protocol for subsequent will-resign-active, did-enter-background, will-enter-foreground and active. Capture raw ticks in fixed ring at callback entry, defer I/O via main queue; preserve boot/PID/timebase and monotonic sequence. Do not reuse the five-hook first-launch completeness rules. Overflow/failure invalidates trial explicitly. No changes to strict existing marker meanings.
identity: Current bootUUID plus original proc_pidpath exact app, proc_pidinfo UID501 and process incarnation. Primary XNU7195 proc_info.h offers proc_bsdinfo pbi_start_tvsec/usec (flavor3) or proc_uniqidentifierinfo (flavor17); installed layout/permission must be checked before use. Current executed reader proves exact path+UID but not new flavors.
